description:
Rilev lets you connect de-identified self-understanding context to ChatGPT so responses can be more personally relevant.

After you authorize read-only access, ChatGPT can use your Rilev outcome patterns, labels, and safe explanations to personalize reflection, planning, journaling, habit support, and growth-focused conversations.

Rilev is for self-understanding and personal growth, not diagnosis, treatment, medication guidance, or professional care. The connector returns only de-identified context. Raw answers, item-level responses, identity information, payment data, Rilev Access Keys, and the full private report are not available through this connector.

defaultPrompt: Why do I lose momentum after starting strong?
Give me 3 side hustle ideas I would stick with
Which one fits me the best, and why?
